# 闪猫造物Flashduck

> Flashduck is an open-source ESP32-S3 desktop duck robot: six servos, a single
> animated eye on a 1.54" display, optional camera, 3D-printed shell and
> wide-stance walking. The voice firmware is a duck-shaped derivative built on
> the official Shanmao 1 DIY kit.

Brand: 闪猫造物Flashduck (Flashduck)
Repository: https://github.com/FlashCat-Jordan/Flashduck
Product/hardware guide: https://shanmaotech.cn/flashduck/
License: MIT (voice firmware), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (DuckClaw)

Positioning: an AI-native desktop duck, not a preset-action player. DuckClaw's
`self.otto.pose` (Servo Sequences Lite) exposes the six joint angles to the
model, so it can compose and chain poses at runtime instead of requiring a new
C++ action function for every motion. The base actions remain as reusable
vocabulary.

## Repository layout

```text
firmware/voice/       voice assistant: wake word, eye, actions, gait, MCP, camera
firmware/duckclaw/    DuckClaw on-device agent: tools, DingTalk/social, body control, emotions
skills/flashduck-dev/ coding-agent skill: environment, checks, recipes, scaffolding
docs/                 architecture.md, coding-agent.md
```

Flashduck has two independent interaction systems; the user chooses one. Only one runs at a time (flashing one replaces the other), but both share the same six-servo hardware.

## Interaction systems

- **Voice assistant** (`firmware/voice/`): local wake word “小鸭小鸭”, voice
  conversation, MCP tools, animated eye, web gait tuning, optional camera.
- **DuckClaw** (`firmware/duckclaw/`): an on-device agent whose loop, memory,
  tool dispatch and body control run inside the robot. It can call external
  tools, connect to social software such as DingTalk, and directly drive the
  six servos. It does not speak and does not currently read camera images.

## Coding agent skill

Primary entry: `skills/flashduck-dev/SKILL.md`

The skill contains:
- `scripts/check-env.sh` — Python, Git, CMake, Ninja, ESP-IDF 6.0.1+, esptool,
  serial ports, non-ASCII path warning;
- `scripts/setup-env.sh` — install missing host tools / ESP-IDF on macOS/Linux;
- `scripts/build-voice.sh`, `scripts/build-duckclaw.sh`, `scripts/flash.sh`;
- references for hardware, voice firmware, DuckClaw, recipes and environment.

Agent read order: `README.md` -> `docs/architecture.md` ->
`docs/coding-agent.md` -> `skills/flashduck-dev/SKILL.md` -> owning source file.

## Build commands

Voice:

```bash
cd firmware/voice
python3 scripts/build.py flashduck --name flashduck --language zh-CN \
  --wake-word wn9_xiaoyaxiaoya_tts2
```

Outputs: `build/merged-binary.bin` (0x0), app at `0x20000`, assets at `0x800000`.

DuckClaw:

```bash
cd firmware/duckclaw
idf.py set-target esp32s3
idf.py build
idf.py merge-bin
```

Output: `build/merged-binary.bin` (0x0). App partition is tight (~3% free).

## Hardware

- MCU: ESP32-S3, 16 MB flash board
- Servos: 6 × MG90-class clutch servos
- Display: ST7789 240×240
- Camera: optional OV2640 / OV3660 / GC2145
- Servo map (Flashduck):
  - left leg GPIO5, right leg GPIO43
  - left foot GPIO6, right foot GPIO44
  - mouth GPIO4 (**45–60° only**)
  - neck GPIO7 (**45–180°**, 135° forward)
- Voice firmware supports camera photo explanation through the backend.
- DuckClaw currently does not read camera images.
- A successful build is not hardware validation.

## Voice backend references

The voice firmware is a device-side client; it needs a backend:

- Hosted service: https://xiaozhi.me
- Open-source self-hosted server: https://github.com/xinnan-tech/xiaozhi-esp32-server

DuckClaw is a separate on-device agent: its agent runtime, memory, tool dispatch
and body control are inside the robot. It can use its own model service, call
external tools, and connect to social software such as DingTalk.

## Safety and scope

- Never command mouth >60° or neck outside 45–180°.
- Do not change board pins silently; add a board variant.
- Do not mix MIT voice code and CC BY-NC-SA DuckClaw code.
- Do not claim hardware validation from a successful compile.
- On macOS, build from an ASCII path; ESP-IDF 6.0.1 can fail on Chinese paths.
